ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the first days

plain.li: I dreamt the colony was new again, just a few of us on bare ground, and everyone I know now arrived one by one.
[quirk:Rimfolk_R5T_Quirk_EarlyDays] I dreamt I was showing someone round the colony as it was at the start, and they couldn't believe how little there was.
[quirk:Rimfolk_R5T_Quirk_NewcomersFriend] I dreamt it was my first day here again, and this time I already knew everyone's name.

warm.li: I dreamt everyone who ever came here sat at one long table, the first ones and the newest, and there was room for all of them.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the first days. Cold, hungry, busy. I woke up glad it's not like that now.

cheerful.li: I dreamt a whole group of newcomers arrived at once, and I got to show every one of them round.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I was new here and nobody would tell me where anything was.

cold.li: I dreamt about how the colony was laid out at the start. Most of it was in the wrong place.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the long game

plain.li: I dreamt the whole colony sat down to one game that went on all night, and nobody could remember the rules.
[quirk:Rimfolk_R5T_Quirk_PlaysToWin] I dreamt I finally won the game, and everyone wanted a rematch, and I won that too.
[quirk:Rimfolk_R5T_Quirk_Peacemaker] I dreamt two people were arguing at the table and I got them to shake hands, and then two more started.

warm.li: I dreamt we all played a game where nobody lost, and it was the best game I've ever played.

cheerful.li: In my dream I beat everyone at every game, even the ones I've never played.

gloomy.li: I dreamt everyone was angry with each other at the table and I couldn't get any of them to stop.

cold.li: I went over the last game in my sleep and found the move I should have made.

plain.li: I dreamt I lost every game I played, one after another, while everyone watched.
I dreamt I was winning, and then the score changed, and nobody would tell me how.
I dreamt I was playing against someone I couldn't see, and I lost every time.

warm.li: I dreamt I lost and everyone was kind about it, which was worse.

blunt.li: Lost all night in my dream. Bad night.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I lost a game to a child and had to pretend I didn't mind.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I lost, and then I lost again, and it never stopped.

cold.li: I dreamt about losing. It was only a dream, but I'll practise more.

plain.li: I dreamt I was small again and one of the old ones showed me how to do something, slowly, until I got it right.
[quirk:Rimfolk_R5T_Quirk_TimeForChildren] I dreamt the colony's children asked me every question they could think of, and I knew every answer.
[quirk:Rimfolk_R5T_Quirk_FollowsTheOld] I dreamt I followed one of the old ones all day, and by the evening I knew everything they knew.

warm.li: I dreamt the old ones and the children were all working in the field together, and it was the best day of the year.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was small. Everyone was tall. That was it.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I was very old and the children followed me everywhere, asking for stories.

gloomy.li: I dreamt the old ones I know were gone, and I couldn't remember what they had told me.

cold.li: I dreamt about learning to work as a child. I remembered more of it than I expected.
